title: 远行与归来 · 十二幕
outline: 一封信、一段旅途，与一次迟来的重逢。十二幕通用故事骨架，可改写为冒险、日常或幻想。

frames.name: 风起的日常
frames.prompt: {character}, {outfit}, {style}, {scene}, {weapon}, a quiet seaside town, distant train tracks, calm summer morning {
frames.caption: 夏日的风经过窗边，故事还没有名字。

frames.name: 未署名的来信
frames.prompt: {character}, {outfit}, {style}, {scene}, {weapon}, holding an old letter, close portrait, delicate eyes
frames.caption: {character_display_name}收到一封没有署名的信，信纸上留着海的气息。

frames.name: 决定出发
frames.prompt: {character}, {outfit}, {style}, {scene}, {weapon}, standing at an open station gate, a journey begins
frames.caption: 有些答案，需要亲自走到远方。

frames.name: 通往海岸的小路
frames.prompt: {character}, {outfit}, {style}, {scene}, {weapon}, cinematic wide landscape, mountain path above the sea
frames.caption: 小路穿过山野，通向记忆里的海岸。

frames.name: 第一个线索
frames.prompt: {character}, {outfit}, {style}, {scene}, {weapon}, an abandoned train platform, warm faded signs
frames.caption: 旧车站的钟，停在我们约定的时刻。

frames.name: 旅途中的同行者
frames.prompt: {character}, {outfit}, {style}, {scene}, {weapon}, two travelers meeting by a harbor, soft light
frames.caption: 她遇见一位旅人，也听见了一段熟悉的往事。

frames.name: 走错的方向
frames.prompt: {character}, {outfit}, {style}, {scene}, {weapon}, a fork in a green mountain path, reflective atmosphere
frames.caption: 错过的岔路，原来也有自己的风景。

frames.name: 风雨将至
frames.prompt: {character}, {outfit}, {style}, {scene}, {weapon}, wind rises over the coast, dramatic soft clouds
frames.caption: 云层渐渐聚拢，风替她收起了迟疑。

frames.name: 独自做出的选择
frames.prompt: {character}, {outfit}, {style}, {scene}, {weapon}, determined expression, wind in hair, dramatic composition
frames.caption: 这一次，{character_display_name}决定不再等待。

frames.name: 灯光下的答案
frames.prompt: {character}, {outfit}, {style}, {scene}, {weapon}, warm lantern at a seaside station, dusk
frames.caption: 远处的灯光亮起，信里的一切终于有了答案。

frames.name: 终于重逢
frames.prompt: {character}, {outfit}, {style}, {scene}, {weapon}, a quiet reunion, silhouette in warm sunset
frames.caption: 那个熟悉的身影，仍站在夏日的光里。

frames.name: 风抵达的地方
frames.prompt: {character}, {outfit}, {style}, {scene}, {weapon}, ocean horizon, gentle wind, hopeful ending
frames.caption: 我们把重逢写进风里，下一段故事从这里开始。
